Build graph data frames for a finger tree

Source: R/70-plotting.R
get_graph_df.Rd

Build graph data frames for a finger tree

Usage

get_graph_df(t)

Arguments

t

FingerTree.

Value

A list with edge and node data frames for igraph plotting.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
t <- as_flexseq(letters[1:4])
gdf <- get_graph_df(t)
names(gdf)
} # }
